value.body: A community mobiliser works on the ground for NGOs and development programmes, building trust with communities and getting people involved in a programme on health, livelihoods, education or sanitation. NGOs, CSR foundations and agencies implementing development projects hire for this work. A typical day involves village or ward visits, group meetings, home visits and recording data.

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Survey forms, mobile data-collection apps, registers

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join an NGO or project as a mobiliser or field coordinator, often in rural or urban low-income areas. Fieldwork from BSW placements and comfort with the local language count heavily.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: field coordinator, programme officer, project manager.
Many posts are tied to project funding and run for fixed terms.
Field travel, sometimes to remote areas, is a regular part of the job.
